propositions: Create a stdlib-only semantic capability registry independent of the command registry, with 14 immutable records mapping semantic keys to packaging extras and missing postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback).
Validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra, every route's possible capability name exists, and no probe imports the optional package.

Enforce capabilities only at selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection (e.g., audit serve before audit show, provider construction before client instantiation), exposing a narrow shared error helper for error postures only.
Preserve existing install guidance, exit/error types, and degraded output shapes; stable verbs and top-level help remain present in a no-extras wheel.
Domain components retain control of result payloads and logging for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures; the registry never manufactures their domain result.
Separate entrypoints mcp_server and review_bot consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry.
